rationale: Fixes PopupWindow closing as focus_lost when activating the application hands key back to the popup's own editor window with no click: the resign-key decision waits one run-loop pass and takes key back in that case, through a pure, table-tested popup_resign_action. Vellum's framework transfer is in effect, so this is a Pulp-only edit; the same fix belongs in Vellum's framework copy as its own change.
